ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes to low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the central notch and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions on the mid-lobes; central black pigmentation radiates from the peduncle attachment in a feathered pattern; distal tips exhibit solid black margins with localized white micro-spotting.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel-calculated angle of 55 degrees; vertex depth is distinct but slightly softened by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations; right lobe displays an irregular macro-notch (tissue loss) approximately 1/3 distance from the center, with a jagged, high-amplitude terminal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature on the upper boundary of both lobes, terminating in sharp, posteriorly-directed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels observed against the dark margins of both distal tips, indicating high-contrast localized scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel chains (rake marks) observed on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the leading to trailing edge; secondary faint horizontal scratches on the left lobe white region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation and tissue disruption on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe lobe; prominent rake mark sets across the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Partial foreground occlusion of the central lower fluke region by a bird (high-intensity white/grey pixels with motion blur).
